interpretation.plain_speak: The detector is much better than its threshold results made it look. It ranks failures above non-failures extremely well: AUROC is about 0.966, and average precision is about 25 times the raw failure rate. The problem is now turning that strong ranking into a selective trigger, not finding a signal from scratch.
interpretation.north_star_question: Confirms meaningful native failure-risk ordering on held-out data while preserving the conclusion that current coarse thresholding is not intervention-ready.
interpretation.next_stage: test whether continuous absolute margin can break ties within frozen rank-plus-temporal risk cells and improve average precision on another held-out phase without fitting
